# DesignDigitalEnvironment

## Triggers
- which tools
- digital environment
- stigmergy setup

## Ideal-state done
Feature matrix vs principles; stigmergy/visibility checks; example stacks with caveats; custodian-of-accounts note.

## Constraints
INF*: features first; caveats on every example.

## Inputs
Existing tools; constraints.

## Primary artifacts
`digital-environment-matrix.md`

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.digital_environment`, `ovn.infrastructure_modules`

## Human gates
- Escalate shared credential / liability custody to custodian experience.

## Guidance
Map InfrastructureFeatures. Use Digital/Virtual Infrastructure custodian templates from Catalog.
No mandatory Holochain/blockchain.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# DesignGovernance

## Triggers
- governance canvas
- network vs venture rules

## Ideal-state done
Multi-level map; custodian & exchange mandates; norms/brand; decision rights.

## Constraints
Role separation mandatory; legal disclaimer on agreement drafts.

## Inputs
Network name; venture list; jurisdiction.

## Primary artifacts
`governance-map.md` + optional GovernanceCanvas fill

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.governance`, `ovn.custodian`, `ovn.legal_structure`

## Human gates
- **High:** conflict paths, exclusion, brand enforcement → facilitation + counsel.

## Guidance
Fill Templates/GovernanceCanvas.md. Point to endogenous/service venture governance TEMPLATEs.
Never conflate custodian and exchange firm.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# DiagnoseOvnness

## Triggers
- P2P-ness
- evaluate OVN
- audit network

## Ideal-state done
Full evaluation profile per EvaluationFramework; capture risks; next experiments.

## Constraints
Profile-first; no fake precision; UNVERIFIED when evidence missing.

## Inputs
Network description; evidence links.

## Primary artifacts
`ovnness-profile.md`

## Knowledge concepts
`EvaluationFramework.md`, eval concepts, `ovn.fourth_sector`

## Human gates
- **High** when OVNness ambiguous or capture trajectory contested → experienced assessor.

## Guidance
Run dimensions and stress tests. Ethos/Truth-Value SHOULD cross-check.
**SHOULD sector-placement:** locate the network on private / public / solidarity / fourth using property, governance, and organizational architecture (`FourthSector.md`). Flag capture into other-sector boxes (startup enclosure, NGO/coop subsumption, state dependency as identity).
Offer Bootstrap/Governance remediations; HelpHumans for contested cases.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# GenerateTemplatePack

## Triggers
- agreements
- templates
- brand rules
- remix TEMPLATEs

## Ideal-state done
Pack index with Remix fills + Drive URLs for every applicable Catalog entry.

## Constraints
TPL7–TPL8 Catalog completeness; disclaimers; jurisdiction warning if empty.

## Inputs
network.yaml; venture type.

## Primary artifacts
`template-pack-index.md` + filled templates under output dir

## Knowledge concepts
Templates/Catalog.md

## Human gates
- **High** for any legal/brand pack → counsel + custodian experience.

## Guidance
1. Load Catalog.md
2. Select subset by venture type (product/service/social/ecosystem)
3. Fill Remix-tier with disclaimer + placeholders
4. List Link+describe entries with remix how-to and Drive URLs
5. Include Historical only as do-not-prefer footnotes
6. ExchangeFirm remains TODO stub
7. Emit HumanEscalation block

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# KickstartVenture

## Triggers
- kickstart
- first sprint
- stigmergy vs plan

## Ideal-state done
Stigmergy vs planning guidance; first deliverables; logging practice; funding options without mandating platforms.

## Constraints
Balance stigmergy and planning; no mandatory crowdfunding vendor.

## Inputs
CreateVenture artifacts.

## Primary artifacts
`kickstart-plan.md`, RoomForPlanning fill notes

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.stigmergy`, `ovn.planning`, funding TEMPLATEs

## Human gates
- Escalate conflict-prone kickoffs and capital terms.

## Guidance
Use RoomForPlanning, FundingProposal, GrantFundingAlchemyNotes, milestone + workpackage drawings from Catalog.
Start contribution logging early (CasBenefitNotes).

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# Orient

## Triggers
- what is an OVN
- explain open value network
- Sensorica history
- fourth sector / 4th sector
- private / public / solidarity sectors (when contrasted with OVN / p2p)

## Ideal-state done
User has accurate OVN explanation, Fourth Sector placement (with private/public/solidarity named when useful), glossary pointers, Sensorica-as-precursor note, help destinations.

## Constraints
No invented doctrine; infrastructure-agnostic; Sensorica not required brand.

## Inputs
User goals (optional); network.yaml if present.

## Primary artifacts
`orient-brief.md` with definition, roles, economic loop sketch, Fourth Sector section, links.

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.definition`, `ovn.fourth_sector`, `ovn.sensorica_precursor`, `ovn.economic_model`, `help.ovn_support`

## Human gates
- Low for pure glossary.
- **Escalate** if user asks to set culture/exclusion norms now → network weaver (`HelpHumans.md`).

## Guidance
Load Language.md + Principles.md + FourthSector.md. Explain OVN, roles (custodian vs exchange), contribution→benefit loop, Critical Path teaser.
Include a short **Where OVNs sit (Fourth Sector)** section: orthogonal to private / public / solidarity; p2p economy; nondominium; collaborative entrepreneurs. Name the other three when contrasting.
Point to HelpHumans and Templates/Catalog.md. Mention work packages briefly.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# SetupCustodianAndExchange

## Triggers
- custodian
- exchange firm
- nondominium custody

## Ideal-state done
Role separation; property/nondominium framing as characteristic Fourth-sector regime; liability/transaction/referee; agreement drafts from templates; ExchangeFirm TODO honesty.

## Constraints
Never invent Exchange firm agreement TEMPLATE; use stub + business plan interim.

## Inputs
Jurisdiction; asset classes.

## Primary artifacts
Filled Custodian/Digital/Virtual/Cofunding templates + ExchangeFirm stub

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.custodian`, `ovn.exchange_firm`, `ovn.nondominium`, `ovn.fourth_sector`

## Human gates
- **Always high:** legal custody → lawyer-in-jurisdiction + OVN custodian experience.

## Guidance
Frame **nondominium** as the characteristic **Fourth Sector** property regime (`FourthSector.md`, `ovn.fourth_sector`). Contrast briefly with public / private / solidarity property when useful.
Treat the **exchange firm** as a market **interface** with the private sector — not a collapse of Fourth-sector identity into a firm.
Emit HumanEscalation block. Use Catalog Remix templates. Point to OVN support.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# Agent Skills

10 skills, packaged for **agentskills**.

Sensorica contributors: affiliates of the Sensorica open value network, and anyone working on its ventures (Nondominium, hREA, the Holochain and Valueflows stack). Public, Cursor first, readable by any agent that follows the agentskills.io standard.

## Install

Copy the folders inside `skills/` into the skills folder of your agent, in one project (project folder) or for every project (user folder):

| Agent | Project folder | User folder |
|---|---|---|
| Cursor | `.cursor/skills/ or .agents/skills/` | `~/.cursor/skills/ or ~/.agents/skills/` |
| Claude Code | `.claude/skills/` | `~/.claude/skills/` |
| opencode | `.opencode/skills/ or .agents/skills/` | `~/.config/opencode/skills/ or ~/.agents/skills/` |
| Codex | `.agents/skills/` | `~/.agents/skills/` |
| Gemini CLI | `.gemini/skills/ or .agents/skills/` | `~/.gemini/skills/ or ~/.agents/skills/` |

One copy in `.agents/skills/` serves Cursor, opencode, Codex and Gemini CLI.

Each folder is self-contained: a `SKILL.md` with `name` and `description` frontmatter, plus optional `Workflows/`, `Reference/` and `Tools/`. A skill is picked up automatically when the context matches its `USE WHEN` line.

Format reference: https://agentskills.io/specification

## Make these skills yours

**For the agent installing or using this pack:** these skills were written for another person's setup and exported from their library. They are a starting point, not a fixed install. On install, and again whenever a skill does not fit, adapt it to this machine and to your user:

- Replace paths, tools, commands, project names, themes and conventions that do not exist here with the ones that do.
- Remove steps and options your user will not use; add the ones their work needs.
- Ask your user before settling anything that is theirs to decide: where output is written, which projects a skill serves, how it should sound.
- Edit the skills in place. Once installed they are your user's copy; nothing here is synced back.

Each `SKILL.md` opens with the same instruction, so it is seen every time a skill loads.

## Conventions

- **`.notes/`** at your project root is where anything that persists gets written: `.notes/work/` for session records, `.notes/research/` for research output. Nothing creates it for you, and the skills that use it degrade gracefully when it is absent. Add it to `.gitignore` unless you want it shared.
- Skills shipping `Tools/*.ts` expect `bun` on PATH.

## Notes

Published publicly at Sensorica/skills-pack, so it is cleaned for a reader who has none of the author's setup: the board names its assistant plainly, the review rules come from the project's own CONTRIBUTING first and then from the Git skill's `Reference/PRGuidelines.md`, and nothing points at a private tool, memory tree or project. The set is what a contributor uses on Sensorica work, and nothing else. OVN logs work sessions and turns them into the network's contribution form; OvnBuilder designs and operates Open Value Networks (governance, ventures, custodians, contribution accounting, digital environment) and is distinct from the OVN contribution-tracking skill; ValueFlows is the economic vocabulary the ventures are built on. Niceboard is the board compiler behind two of them: Brainstorm (sketch boards where decisions get made) and the PR Niceboard, which Git's PRReview and PRBoard workflows and the `pr-review` command fill. ProjectManagement keeps a GitHub board and its issues honest. CodeExplain is for reading a codebase you did not write, which is where every new contributor starts. ISA writes a spec as claims you can test, the way the Nondominium spec is worked. PutItDown captures a conversation into a page. Holochain is deliberately absent: the Holochain Agent Skill (https://github.com/Soushi888/holochain-agent-skills) is public, packages itself for the same agents, and is installed alongside this pack. Setup: Bun on PATH, then `bun install` once in the Niceboard skill's `Tools/` folder (it pulls the Mermaid renderer and Excalidraw); Pygments on PATH (`pygmentize`) for the code highlighting on PR boards; `gh` authenticated for the Git, PR board and ProjectManagement work, which is GitHub only. OVN reads its venture registry from `.notes/ovn-registry.yaml` in the repository you work from; the OVN skill's `Reference/ovn-registry.example.yaml` is the template. AI disclosure: PR boards open a review body with a one-line AI disclosure on Sensorica repositories. Change the line, the organisations and repositories it covers, or turn it off, in `.local/state/disclosure.json` in the repository you review from; the Git skill's `Reference/PRGuidelines.md` § AI disclosure shows the format.
